subject.title: fix(memory-core): honor private-network settings for OpenAI-compatible embeddings

question: Should memory embeddings inherit `models.providers.<id>.request.allowPrivateNetwork` for configured OpenAI-compatible providers, including explicit `false` disabling exact-host private endpoint trust?
rationale: This is a security and upgrade-policy choice: the code path is coherent, but it changes which runtime path consumes an existing private-network trust flag and how an explicit denial behaves for existing configured memory endpoints.

options.title: Accept Provider-Policy Inheritance
options.body: Land the PR once maintainers explicitly accept that memory embeddings reuse the provider request trust contract and that explicit `false` fails closed for private endpoints.

options.title: Revise Explicit-False Semantics
options.body: Change the policy builder and tests if maintainers want `false` to deny only broad private-network access while preserving exact configured-host trust.

options.title: Require A Memory-Owned Trust Surface
options.body: Pause or close this PR if memory embeddings should use a separate trust knob instead of inheriting model-provider transport policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Provider-Policy Inheritance
recommendation.body: Land the PR once maintainers explicitly accept that memory embeddings reuse the provider request trust contract and that explicit `false` fails closed for private endpoints.

likelyOwner.reason: Kaspre is the strongest history match for the adjacent SSRF trust-boundary contract being extended here.
